title: Period Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the period using T = 2π√(LC) and obtains approximately 6.28×10⁻⁴ s.

title: Current Trend Analysis
description: Essential: Correctly determines whether the current is increasing or decreasing at t=9.0×10⁻³ s.

title: Capacitor State Analysis
description: Essential: Correctly identifies whether the capacitor is charging or discharging at t=9.0×10⁻³ s.

title: Phase Relationship Application
description: Important: Applies the correct phase relationship between capacitor voltage and inductor current in an LC circuit.

title: Time-Period Comparison
description: Important: Correctly compares the given time to the period to determine the phase of oscillation.

title: Energy Transfer Understanding
description: Optional: Demonstrates understanding of energy transfer between capacitor and inductor during oscillation.

title: Unit Consistency Check
description: Optional: Shows proper unit conversion (mH to H, μF to F) in calculations.

title: Sign/Phase Confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses the phase relationship between voltage and current, leading to incorrect trend analysis.

title: Charging/Discharging Misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets what constitutes charging versus discharging of the capacitor.
